metadata.name: invoices
metadata.comment: Unified invoices table replicating legacy tracker.v_invoices for operational and reporting use

id.name: id
id.comment: Internal system record identifier for the invoice in Tracker

job.name: job
job.comment: Job name for job-linked invoices or project name for project-linked invoices

state.name: state
state.comment: State from invoice for job-linked invoices, or from project for project-linked invoices

business_unit.name: business_unit
business_unit.comment: Business unit from invoice for job-linked invoices, or Projects for project-linked invoices

created_date.name: created_date
created_date.comment: Date the invoice was created in Tracker

issue_date.name: issue_date
issue_date.comment: Date the invoice was issued (converted to Australia/Melbourne timezone)

due_date.name: due_date
due_date.comment: Date the invoice payment is due

ispaid.name: ispaid
ispaid.comment: Flag indicating whether the invoice has been paid

invoice_number.name: invoice_number
invoice_number.comment: Invoice number, preferring Xero invoice number, falling back to MYOB reference

stats_off.label: Stats Off
stats_off.description: Number that indicates how stale the table statistics are; 0 is current, 100 is out of date.

encoded.label: Encoded
encoded.description: Indicates whether any column in the table has compression encoding defined.

skew_rows.label: Skew Rows
skew_rows.description: Ratio of the number of rows in the slice with the most rows to the number of rows in the slice with the fewest rows.

max_varchar.label: Max Varchar
max_varchar.description: Size of the largest column that uses a VARCHAR data type.

size.label: Approximate Size
size.description: Approximate size of the table, calculated from a count of 1MB blocks

rows.label: Approximate Row Count
rows.description: Approximate number of rows in the table. This value includes rows marked for deletion, but not yet vacuumed.

sortkey1.label: Sort Key 1
sortkey1.description: First column in the sort key.

pct_used.label: Disk Utilization
pct_used.description: Percent of available space that is used by the table.

diststyle.label: Dist Style
diststyle.description: Distribution style or distribution key column, if key distribution is defined.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: invoices_reporting
metadata.comment: Invoice reporting table replicating legacy tracker.v_invoices_reporting, enriched with MYOB and Xero data for financial reconciliation.

id.name: id
id.comment: Internal system record identifier for the invoice in Tracker

report_date.name: report_date
report_date.comment: Reporting date, preferring MYOB report date, then Xero date, then Tracker issue date

system_report_date.name: system_report_date
system_report_date.comment: Issue date as recorded in Tracker

month_match.name: month_match
month_match.comment: Whether report_date and system_report_date fall in the same calendar month

created_date.name: created_date
created_date.comment: Date the invoice record was created in Tracker

value_ex_gst.name: value_ex_gst
value_ex_gst.comment: Invoice value excluding GST, preferring MYOB then Xero then Tracker amount

invoice_number.name: invoice_number
invoice_number.comment: Invoice number from MYOB or Xero

system_invoice_number.name: system_invoice_number
system_invoice_number.comment: Invoice reference stored in Tracker (MYOB ref or Xero invoice id)

reference.name: reference
reference.comment: Job name for job-linked invoices, project name for project-linked invoices

business_unit.name: business_unit
business_unit.comment: Business unit from job, or Projects for project-linked invoices

division.name: division
division.comment: Reporting division derived from business unit

division_match.name: division_match
division_match.comment: Whether Tracker division matches MYOB division

state_match.name: state_match
state_match.comment: Whether Tracker state matches MYOB state

sales_email.name: sales_email
sales_email.comment: Email address of the salesperson associated with the job or project

ops_email.name: ops_email
ops_email.comment: Email address of the operations person associated with the job or project

stats_off.label: Stats Off
stats_off.description: Number that indicates how stale the table statistics are; 0 is current, 100 is out of date.

skew_sortkey1.label: Sort Key Skew
skew_sortkey1.description: Ratio of the size of the largest non-sort key column to the size of the first column of the sort key.

encoded.label: Encoded
encoded.description: Indicates whether any column in the table has compression encoding defined.

skew_rows.label: Skew Rows
skew_rows.description: Ratio of the number of rows in the slice with the most rows to the number of rows in the slice with the fewest rows.

max_varchar.label: Max Varchar
max_varchar.description: Size of the largest column that uses a VARCHAR data type.

size.label: Approximate Size
size.description: Approximate size of the table, calculated from a count of 1MB blocks

rows.label: Approximate Row Count
rows.description: Approximate number of rows in the table. This value includes rows marked for deletion, but not yet vacuumed.

sortkey_num.label: # Sort Keys
sortkey_num.description: Number of columns defined as sort keys.

unsorted.label: Unsorted %
unsorted.description: Percent of unsorted rows in the table.

sortkey1.label: Sort Key 1
sortkey1.description: First column in the sort key.

pct_used.label: Disk Utilization
pct_used.description: Percent of available space that is used by the table.

diststyle.label: Dist Style
diststyle.description: Distribution style or distribution key column, if key distribution is defined.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table
